narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think if a law works for many rectangles, it must work for all of them.
<bookmark mark='endless'/>There are endless sizes of rectangle, and nobody can measure every one of them.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Many examples give a strong hint, but a hint is not the same as being sure.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check your reason, ask if it uses only facts that are true for every rectangle.
<bookmark mark='avoid'/>A reason that leans on one drawing or one ruler reading does not make us sure.
